map.💡 公式：每公顷株数 N = 株数 ÷ 样地面积 × 10000；林分密度指数: 💡 Formula: trees per hectare N = tree count ÷ plot area × 10000; stand density index SDI = N × (D÷25)^1.6 (Reineke); basal area G = N × π×D²÷4 ÷ 10000 (m²/ha).
map.SDI 参考胸径为 25cm，SDI 越大林分越密，一般 ≥600 为过密: The SDI reference diameter is 25cm; the larger the SDI the denser the stand, and ≥600 is generally taken as over-dense

map.每公顷株数 N=n/面积×10000；林分密度指数 SDI=N×(DBH/25): Trees per hectare N=n/area×10000; stand density index SDI=N×(DBH/25)^1.6 (reference diameter 25 cm); single-tree basal area g=π·DBH²/4/10000, basal area per hectare G=N×g. SDI classes: <200 too sparse, 200-350 somewhat sparse, 350-550 moderate, 550-700 somewhat dense, ≥700 over-dense.
map.样地 600 m²、株数 80、平均胸径 16 cm：N=1333 株/ha，S: A 600 m² plot with 80 trees and a mean breast diameter of 16 cm: N=1333 trees/ha, SDI=1333×(16/25)^1.6≈652.9 (somewhat dense, thinning recommended), G=1333×0.0201≈26.8 m²/ha.
map.SDI 越大越密吗？: Does a larger SDI mean denser?
map.是的。SDI 综合株数与胸径，消除密度与平均直径的此消彼长，≥600 一般视为过: Yes. SDI combines tree count and diameter, cancelling out the trade-off between density and mean diameter; ≥600 is generally treated as over-dense and is an important thinning reference, but it must be read together with species and site.
map.为什么参考胸径取 25 cm？: Why is the reference diameter 25 cm?
map.25 cm 是北美通用 SDI 基准胸径，便于不同林分横向比较；若用其他基准需注: 25 cm is the standard North American SDI reference diameter, which makes different stands comparable; using another baseline means stating and converting it so the conclusion stays consistent.
